name: diagrams
description: Draw validated, themeable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams as interactive HTML

interface.shortDescription: Draw validated, themeable diagrams as interactive HTML
interface.longDescription: One skill, creating-diagrams, that draws architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams as self-contained interactive HTML. A bundled engine (vendored archify, Node 18+, no install) lays out and routes the diagram, runs geometry checks, and delivers it with receipts; the viewer offers light and dark modes, search, focus, guided views, and PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG/WebM export. Colors come only from themes, which can be derived from a presentations preset or a PowerPoint template so diagrams match a corporate brand.
defaultPrompt: Draw an architecture diagram of this repository
